note: Founder decision for all five Motion apps (USD base). Store consoles hold the authoritative per-region prices; the app shows store-localized prices only. Console creation/readback is a user input.
accessModel: First part of every course free (shortest whole-module prefix covering >= 1/3 of lessons); remaining lessons need a Lissom or Motion+ subscription; practice records always readable.
motionPlusScope: Unlocks the paid parts of all five Motion apps (Lissom, Gravita, JabLab, Ostinato, Choreia) for the same Motion account.
notIncluded: Camera sessions stay closed in this release.
